func _init():

func generate():
	var root = Control.new()
	root.name = "DialogUI"
	root.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400, 300)
	# Attach the script.
	var script = preload("res://scripts/DialogUI.gd")
	root.set_script(script)
	
	var speaker = Label.new()
	speaker.name = "SpeakerLabel"
	root.add_child(speaker)
	speaker.owner = root
	
	var body = RichTextLabel.new()
	body.name = "BodyLabel"
	body.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400, 100)
	root.add_child(body)
	body.owner = root
	
	var choices = VBoxContainer.new()
	choices.name = "ChoicesContainer"
	root.add_child(choices)
	choices.owner = root
	
	# Layout using containers (basic vertical layout).
	var vb = VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.name = "Layout"
	vb.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	vb.anchor_right = 1.0
	# Re-parent the elements under a layout container.
	for child in root.get_children():

			vb.add_child(child)
			child.owner = root
	root.add_child(vb)
	vb.owner = root
	
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("res://scenes")
	var scene = PackedScene.new()
	scene.pack(root)
	var err = ResourceSaver.save(scene, "res://scenes/DialogUI.tscn")
	if err != OK:

		quit(1)
